draft.shortGloss: to play (an instrument); to turn away from
notes: This verb is almost exclusively used for playing musical instruments. For playing sports or games, use the verb لَعِبَ (laʿiba) instead.
The preposition ʿan (عَنْ) is often used with this verb when it means 'to turn away from' or 'to lose interest in' something.
